cursorDevelopmentBaselineSubject: Publish the Union Eyes agent lane contract.
integrationHeadRule: The integration HEAD is git rev-parse agents/ue-final-convergence and moves as the integrator commits. Cursor's development baseline stays fde81a81a088a1c8c4aa6d498b2b3a52e0dea298. That baseline is not the Git merge base against origin/main. Before a handoff, fde81a81a088a1c8c4aa6d498b2b3a52e0dea298 must be an ancestor of the Cursor tip. Review git diff --name-status fde81a81a088a1c8c4aa6d498b2b3a52e0dea298...<cursor-tip> and git log --oneline fde81a81a088a1c8c4aa6d498b2b3a52e0dea298..<cursor-tip>. Reject a range that includes commits already on the integration branch. A conflict-free textual merge is not semantic compatibility.
contractGapRule: A missing field, route, or proof on a shared contract is reported to the integrator. The integrator changes the canonical contract and republishes this record. Cursor then consumes that contract. Cursor does not fork schema, migrations, ontology, the capability registry, route ratchets, or case authorization.

integrationProtocol.differenceReport: git diff --name-status fde81a81a088a1c8c4aa6d498b2b3a52e0dea298...<cursor-tip> must contain only cursorMayEdit paths. git merge-base origin/main <cursor-tip> may still be 0c994b968aed0657cca5b702954ba87252408245 and is not the review range.
integrationProtocol.overlap: Overlapping paths are resolved by keeping the canonical contract on the integration branch.
integrationProtocol.method: Conflict-free cherry-pick or a controlled merge. Do not overwrite either side blindly.
integrationProtocol.validation: Affected tests, kernel authorization proofs, route ratchets, schema validation, and the relevant database suite run after integration.
integrationProtocol.register: docs/union-eyes/convergence/UE_CONVERGENCE_REGISTER.json records each integrated Cursor commit ID.

reservedCanonicalContracts.contract: Short-lived, ownership-bound intake cleanup. A stored-but-unattached upload is described by an intake record bound to organization, uploader, the exact blob path, a content hash and an expiry measured in minutes. Cleanup may remove only a blob with a live, unconsumed intake record owned by the caller; creating the document consumes the record. A client-supplied path, or a path that merely carries the organization prefix, is never deletion authority. Expired records are reaped by a governed job, with an audit entry per deletion.
reservedCanonicalContracts.cursorMustNot: Delete a blob from a client-supplied path, or from an organization prefix match.

reservedCanonicalContracts.contract: OCR processing authority. Processing a document or uploaded file is an action decided by the kernel for the linked case (read or upload_evidence as the integrator specifies), on the transaction that does the work. A caller-asserted hasCaseAccess flag is not an input. Unlinked documents follow the document-level rule (uploader, explicit download grant, organization-level documents only for the document authority). The decision and the extracted-text hash are audited.
reservedCanonicalContracts.cursorMustNot: Pass hasCaseAccess: true, or derive case access from a role or a label.

reservedCanonicalContracts.contract: Durable audit of document creation without a case link. The document, its first version and its audit record commit together under persistAtomicAudit; a refused create (denied, hash mismatch, storage reuse) is recorded on the denial path without a document existing. No create path may skip the audit because it has no linked entity.
reservedCanonicalContracts.cursorMustNot: Add a second create path, or create a document row outside the repository route.

reservedCanonicalContracts.contract: Governed reviewed-transcript writes. OCR or transcription output is a candidate until a named human reviews it. A reviewed transcript is a new, hash-bound artifact linked to the source document version, written under the kernel document-modification decision (or the uploader rule for unlinked documents), versioned, and audited with reviewer, source version and text hash. Unreviewed output is never stored as document content or as a document version.
reservedCanonicalContracts.cursorMustNot: Write OCR output into documents, document_versions or metadata without the reviewed-transcript contract.
